ITEM 1 | Single wedge-shaped slice on the upper right edge of the plate, about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide at its widest; golden-tan crust edge with a pale, slightly glossy white cheese layer covering most of the top and light orange-red spotting; a round, deep red-orange disc with a slightly darker rim sits on top near the crust, with a second disc partly visible at the lower edge, both with a matte, slightly greasy sheen; cheese is soft, stretched-looking and holds its shape with a thin flat profile of about 1 cm; no visible char, cut through the wedge tip-to-crust | 85

ITEM 2 | Scattered tiny crumbs and specks of pale golden-brown material on the white plate surface and the glass table beside it, each under 0.5 cm, dry and matte, no sauce or liquid present | 2
